room denmark (order 480) done: 19 second-order themes placed in existing kinds (37 placements; 18 rule 0 lines; three bags in b1b23_bags_denmark.txt: t04 kept in T3-068, t05 in T3-010, t13 in T3-126). The national sub whose flag fought Sweden and whose crowd broke its word at the end: calls and coordinates (T3-002, T3-070), Dannebrog built, measured and sited (T3-065, T3-004, T3-020), defended with timed recaptures (T3-005, T3-167, T3-021), Norwegian, Swedish, Latvian and Austrian flags turned Danish (T3-068 bag), truces, unions and neighbours' pleas (T3-010 bag), Discord, a bot and console code (T3-014, T3-028), megathreads and removals (T3-015, T3-063), explaining and correcting false alarms (T3-016, T3-170), celebrations, recounting and thanks (T3-009, T3-073, T3-043), Kaj, Andrea and the Viking ship (T3-041, T3-056, T3-068), the room's own April Fools T3-001, war talk with Holger Danske, the Stockholm Bloodbath and Valhalla, taunts and timed operations (T3-081, T3-050, T3-167), rogue placers, broken promises and apologies (T3-126 bag), the sub smashed or enlivened (T3-075, T3-015, T3-157), successor canvases T3-054, a map question T3-017, a cryptic picture joke T3-031, new-user rules (T3-185, T3-017), the Discord kept as community space (T3-111, T3-014). National content placed plainly: the Swedish war, Sweden compared with Nazis and a Swedish swastika, the flags of Norway, Latvia and Austria taken, Hungarians calling the Danes warmongers. Episodes: joined E474 with denmark, norge, norway, thenetherlands, finland, france and ainbowroad (the Danish flag taken by Sweden), E191 (the Blond overwrite), E276 with denmark and ainbowroad (the LEGO logo), E277 with denmark and elitedangerous (the raid on New Zealand), E248 (the Viking ship); new E758 and E759 ainbowroad (the road split around Dannebrog; the mini flags and expansion), E760 Fez (Gomez), E761 hungary (the border and heart at the close), E762 latvia, E763 norge and norway (late calls on each other's flags). A helper written this leg, b1_split_spec.py, splits a join spec so entries for one episode apply one after another; b1_episode_join.py applies only the last entry per episode in one run. One-sided: twice's record of Danish expansion over TWICE (Danish members writing there) and canada's Hans Island call are not told in r/denmark's record.
